_k__98_: Viktor K came up with a draft of replacements on Day 11. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Viktor K watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper. Viktor K asked to leave the field cooks and serve as a sniper. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.

Roland Dav lent Viktor K a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'. A letter from home found Viktor K before the night shift. Viktor K folded it small and kept it close.

A bullet hit the sandbag beside Viktor K. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway. A letter from home found Viktor K before the night shift. Viktor K folded it small and kept it close.
Wiring party. Viktor K held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at N-F16, and everyone came back.
Viktor K traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not.

Viktor K counted the steps of the Hegemony sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Silas "Mud" Beckforder never saw the shovel coming. (@beckforder873) Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Viktor K only heard boots on the duckboards at N-F16, then nothing but pain. Raider: Bram Foxeye of the Hegemony (@foxeye5).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Viktor K is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Viktor rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Valentin Servantmc was gravely wounded at the far edge of no man's land.
_michael_roos_01: After 2 days of war, R-F19 had a place for everything. On Day 3, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Teodor Roos.
Teodor Roos and Otto Elitecelebs carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
Teodor Roos won a gold tooth at cards from a lance corporal in R-F19. The lance corporal wants a rematch.

Rain all night. Teodor Roos bailed water out of R-F19 with a helmet until his hands stopped feeling anything. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Teodor Roos helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Pavel "Crow" Hayden and Teodor Roos argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
Rematch. Teodor Roos lost everything he won, plus a pressed cornflower. The whole dugout watched.
Teodor Roos made soup from what the rats left. The men called it the best soup on the front, and they were not joking.
Third game, by candlelight, with the shelling for a clock. Teodor Roos won back a pressed cornflower and nothing else. He says that was all he was playing for.

Teodor Roos was on the dawn watch at R-F19 when the Concord raiders came. A club, a shout, and Teodor Roos was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Rafael "Whistle" Seankukhta of the Concord (@seankukhta). Teodor Roos walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Teodor Roos came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon. The clerk counted the names twice. Teodor Roos is number 205 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Teodor Roos did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
A rat stole Teodor Roos's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier.

Teodor Roos was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-F19. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Bastian "Mud" Decybecy of the Concord (@decybecy66).
Teodor Roos rejoined the squad at R-F19. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
Teodor Roos has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment.
The Concord raiders were in and out in two minutes. At R-F19 they left Teodor Roos behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Albin "Parson" Beniiioz of the Concord (@beniiioz).
Benedikt Roos came to the front because his uncle Teodor Roos never came home. He carries a pressed cornflower.
Benedikt Roos carried hot tea up to the front line in petrol cans. Everyone could taste the petrol. Everyone drank it.
Benedikt obtained a recipe for a batch of potato cakes. The instructions assume a kitchen, a steady fire and ingredients that do not arrive in sacks.
adamjedlicka28: Hugo Adamjedlicka found a place in R-S12 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
Walter "Ghost" Wizzerd and Hugo Adamjedlicka both swear they saw a ghost at Blackwater Canal. Each says the other screamed first.
Hugo Adamjedlicka got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached R-S12 with the rations. Hugo Adamjedlicka ate while listening to the revised orders.

Hugo Adamjedlicka fired at the enemy dawn watch from R-S12. Wendel What was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. The clerk counted the names twice. Hugo Adamjedlicka is number 469 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Hugo Adamjedlicka read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Hugo Adamjedlicka had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Tobias Dilloncoll was grazed.

A bullet found Hugo Adamjedlicka at R-S12, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Konrad Jngaf of the Hegemony (@gremlin_jngaf). Across from R-S12, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Hugo Adamjedlicka saw it. Silas Cosmicloopy was badly wounded.
Hugo Adamjedlicka lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
The medics would not give up on Hugo Adamjedlicka. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to R-S12 today.

The Hegemony sentry, Hugo Jameson, shouted once. Hugo Adamjedlicka silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@trey15jameson) Hugo Adamjedlicka threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Ivo Souptime was down and screaming for a medic. (@souptime13) Hugo Adamjedlicka made it into the enemy trench and out again. Twenty yards from home, a single shot ended it. Killed in the night raid by Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745).
The House of Adamjedlicka sent another. Emil "Crow" Adamjedlicka, cousin of Hugo Adamjedlicka, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.

A bullet struck Emil "Crow" Adamjedlicka below the ribs at R-S12. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Emil "Crow" Mangotto of the Hegemony (@mangotto.id). The bearers reached Emil "Crow" Adamjedlicka at R-S12 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Emil "Crow" Mangotto of the Hegemony (@mangotto.id).
Another member of the House of Adamjedlicka reached the line: Valentin Adamjedlicka. He asked where Emil "Crow" Adamjedlicka had slept, then chose a different corner.
Valentin listened to a corporal tell the same story for the fourth time. The ending changed again.
connorboi308: Cyril Connorboi, a brewer from Oakmere, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in T-F12. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Cyril Connorboi read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Cyril Connorboi counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Bastian Passing was badly wounded. Grey Mill is lost. Cyril Connorboi heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Cyril Connorboi fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Ulrich Schizophreni was gravely wounded. Cyril Connorboi ate breakfast without a word. Cyril Connorboi was hit in the forearm at T-F12. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Viktor Pauar of the Hegemony (@nea_pauar).
Three days with a bandage, and Cyril Connorboi is back at T-F12. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
The cook borrowed Cyril Connorboi's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Cyril Connorboi waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found.
Cyril Connorboi watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been.
Cyril Connorboi lay behind a dead tree trunk at T-F12 for six hours without moving. One shot at dusk. Edmund Mollard was grazed.
Cyril was told not to fire until the order came. The order did not come. He lay still for eight hours anyway.
cowardlygaming1412: In Varenne, Konrad "Smokes" Cowardlygami was a medical student. In S-R16, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a medical student again.

The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Konrad "Smokes" Cowardlygami watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools. Konrad "Smokes" Cowardlygami's transfer to the role of stretcher bearer was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

Konrad "Smokes" Cowardlygami was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Konrad "Smokes" Cowardlygami answered to number 974. Grey Mill is lost. Konrad "Smokes" Cowardlygami heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Konrad "Smokes" Cowardlygami as a story about a general. The ending was the same.
The old Private did not come back from the wire. Konrad "Smokes" Cowardlygami wears his stripes now: Lance Corporal.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Konrad "Smokes" Cowardlygami asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
A patient apologized for bleeding on Konrad "Smokes" Cowardlygami's sleeve. He told the patient to concentrate on staying awake.
Konrad "Smokes" Cowardlygami and Rafael Zacharyhill share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.

Konrad "Smokes" Cowardlygami was hit hard at Verdel Ridge. Two men carried him down the communication trench on a door torn from a ruin. Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Konrad "Smokes" Cowardlygami died waiting. The men at S-R16 have not stopped talking about it.
A letter came with Otto Cowardlygami: "I am Konrad "Smokes" Cowardlygami's cousin. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
A bullet nicked Otto's boot at S-R16. The heel is gone. So is a little skin. Shot by Edmund "Rabbit" Gefocheh of the Hegemony (@gefocheh2050).
demirkeskin06: Isidor "Owl" Demirkeskin came up the line with a tin of tobacco and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

Isidor "Owl" Demirkeskin went in with a pistol and a trench club. In the Concord trench Roland Archiegregor put up a fight, but not for long. (@archiegregorysmith) Isidor "Owl" Demirkeskin jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Quentin Rocco. The Concord medics will be busy. (@ben._.rocco) The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Isidor "Owl" Demirkeskin did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again. Mail came up the line with a letter for Isidor "Owl" Demirkeskin. Isidor "Owl" Demirkeskin read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Isidor "Owl" Demirkeskin had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Nils Mrpickypants was gravely wounded. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Isidor "Owl" Demirkeskin answered to number 778. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Isidor "Owl" Demirkeskin helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Isidor "Owl" Demirkeskin fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag was grazed. Isidor "Owl" Demirkeskin ate breakfast without a word.
Isidor "Owl" Demirkeskin tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog.
Isidor "Owl" Demirkeskin fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Pavel "Ghost" Williambecke, now badly wounded.
Isidor "Owl" Demirkeskin failed to return from the wire. A search found tracks leading into churned ground and nothing certain beyond it.
The sentry nearly shot Isidor "Owl" Demirkeskin coming in through the wire. He had been lost near the Sunken Road for two days, living on puddle water and stubbornness.
Casimir "Button" Maupat fell asleep on watch. Isidor "Owl" Demirkeskin took over without waking Button, and told the sergeant nothing.
The sergeant at S-C11 called out a range and a spot. Isidor was the only one who hit it. Otto Saigohasegaw was gravely wounded.
dvic33: They issued Matthias "Hollow" Dvic a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a dented harmonica in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
Matthias "Hollow" Dvic lay in the ruins of Hill 304 from dawn to dusk. He did not fire once. That is also a kind of victory.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-S16 with the rations. Matthias "Hollow" Dvic ate while listening to the revised orders.

Matthias "Hollow" Dvic and Gideon Mirwik share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship. Matthias "Hollow" Dvic got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 563. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-S16. Matthias "Hollow" Dvic has learned to walk bent double.

Matthias "Hollow" Dvic took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at S-S16, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Otto Dalev of the Hegemony (@dalev44).
A medic brought Matthias "Hollow" Dvic half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real.
Matthias "Hollow" Dvic healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.
Matthias "Hollow" Dvic had watched a loose sandbag in the enemy wall for two days. This morning it moved. Gustav Naterrwaterr was grazed.

Matthias "Hollow" Dvic crawled through a gap in the Hegemony wire and slid into their trench. Valentin Thebaileebla reached for a rifle. Matthias "Hollow" Dvic was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@thebaileeblanks) Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Matthias "Hollow" Dvic landed next to Norbert Cheese in the Hegemony trench. Only Matthias "Hollow" Dvic climbed back out. (@halo_of_cheese) Matthias "Hollow" Dvic made it into the enemy trench and out again. Twenty yards from home, a single shot ended it. Killed in the night raid by Valentin Cbeattie of the Hegemony (@cbeattie.1770).
Rafael "Ghost" Dvic arrived carrying the family name of Matthias "Hollow" Dvic. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Rafael "Ghost" Dvic traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.
Rafael found an old map of the Hanging Bridge from before the war. There was a school on it, and an orchard. He looked for them. He did not find them.
finn__thehuman___: Day 6. The corporal put Walter Thehuman beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Walter Thehuman tried to describe the smell of Greyhallow and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived. A letter from home found Walter Thehuman before the night shift. Walter Thehuman folded it small and kept it close.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Walter Thehuman was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.
Walter Thehuman taught Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.
A stretcher party needed the passage. Walter Thehuman backed into a recess with an ammunition box and stayed there until the last bearer passed.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-S6 changed before the cheering ended. Walter Thehuman shouldered another load.

Walter Thehuman and Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes both swear they saw a ghost at Calvary Farm. Each says the other screamed first. Walter Thehuman got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 419. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Walter Thehuman did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
A replacement turned out to be from Greyhallow too. Walter Thehuman and the newcomer argued about the same bakery for half the night.
A shell hit the latrine at R-S6. Nobody was hurt. Walter Thehuman says it was the best day of the war.

Walter Thehuman had just lit a cigarette at R-S6 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney of the Concord (@qhmullaney).
The medic cut the last bandage off Walter Thehuman's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to R-S6 the same hour.
Walter Thehuman found a flower growing out of a sandbag. He did not tell anyone. He checks on it every morning.
Walter Thehuman borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.
The cook borrowed Walter's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
han.ethan_fish: On Day 9 Henrik "Button" Fish took a post at R-R12 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He keeps feeding the rats, and the men liked him for it.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-R12, Henrik "Button" Fish listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

A bucket appeared above the Hegemony parapet at Grey Mill. Henrik "Button" Fish fired. Bastian Hughsim pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.' The clerk counted the names twice. Henrik "Button" Fish is number 869 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Henrik "Button" Fish wrote to an old neighbor who promised to keep his garden alive that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Henrik "Button" Fish flashed a lamp signal to the battery behind the ridge. The answer came back: a single word, misspelled.
Yann Mixtapethepy and Henrik "Button" Fish spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1.
Henrik "Button" Fish put an empty tin under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal.
Henrik "Button" Fish tested the telephone and heard someone at headquarters chewing. The line was declared perfectly clear.
The parcel for Henrik "Button" Fish contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
Henrik "Button" Fish sent a pigeon back to headquarters. The pigeon came back two hours later. Henrik "Button" Fish took it personally.
Henrik watched the sun rise from the fire step and thought of nothing. It was the best part of the day.
haydnburrell_9thky: Dietrich Thky told the sergeant he was a choir singer. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed more rain, and put him on sentry.

Dietrich Thky opened a parcel addressed in an unfamiliar hand. Inside was a note explaining that the usual letter writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first. The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Dietrich Thky looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Dietrich Thky cleaned the gun for the fourth time today. The gun is the only thing in the trench that is kept dry.
Dietrich Thky talks to his rifle. Today, under fire at Sorrow Copse, that habit was the only steady thing in S-F16.

Wiring party. Dietrich Thky held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at S-F16, and everyone came back. Dietrich Thky had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Clement "Lucky" Johnrant crossed it, Dietrich Thky fired. Clement "Lucky" Johnrant was badly wounded. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Dietrich Thky wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
A bucket appeared above the Concord parapet at Hill 304. Dietrich Thky fired. Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.'
Dietrich Thky fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Bram Eccentricred, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.

Dietrich Thky fed a new belt into the gun and laid it on the enemy path at S-F16. Before dawn Norbert Bwk walked into it, grazed. Dietrich Thky was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at S-F16. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Norbert Seamus of the Concord (@seamus_bj). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Dietrich Thky fell at S-F16 and never moved again. Shot by Norbert Seamus of the Concord (@seamus_bj).
Valentin Thky arrived carrying the family name of Dietrich Thky. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Oskar "Spark" Person and Valentin Thky made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.

At S-F16 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Valentin Thky turned around and took a shovel blow. Yann Theanimator of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Yann Theanimator of the Concord (@nico.theanimator). Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Valentin Thky watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

A bullet hit Valentin Thky in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at S-F16. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Arno Olie of the Concord (@olie300). Valentin Thky was killed at S-F16 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Arno Olie of the Concord (@olie300).

Another member of the House of Thky reached the line: Severin Thky. He asked where Valentin Thky had slept, then chose a different corner. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Severin Thky answered to number 166. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Severin Thky helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
A bullet went through Severin Thky's sleeve at S-F16 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Arno "Crow" Hakkinen of the Concord (@henri.hakkinen.566).
Severin Thky no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Severin Thky spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at S-F16 is closed now.
Severin Thky pressed his ear to the tunnel wall under Blackwater Canal and heard it: tapping. Someone is digging toward him.
Severin Thky tried to remember the price of a loaf in Marrow Fen. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.

A bullet went through Severin Thky's upper arm at S-F16 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Benedikt "Spark" Mini of the Concord (@mini_i.r.s). The bearers reached Severin Thky at S-F16 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Benedikt "Spark" Mini of the Concord (@mini_i.r.s).
Hugo "Shadow" Thky asked about Severin Thky on arriving at S-F16. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
Hugo was reaching for a canteen at S-F16 when a round tore the strap in two. It also tore a line across his hand. Shot by Pavel Seamus of the Concord (@seamus_bj).
henri.hakkinen.566: The draft reached S-F17 on Day 3. Arno "Crow" Hakkinen was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore. The Concord flag went up over Verdel Ridge. Arno "Crow" Hakkinen did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Arno "Crow" Hakkinen is Lance Corporal now. At supper, a recruit waited for him to sit before taking a place. He noticed.
Arno "Crow" Hakkinen was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.

Arno "Crow" Hakkinen fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Emil Theramblingb, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into S-F17. Arno "Crow" Hakkinen has learned to walk bent double.
Arno "Crow" Hakkinen cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt.
Arno "Crow" Hakkinen cut Jonas "Mole" Biesc's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.
Bram Archiegregor fixed the strap on Arno "Crow" Hakkinen's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
Arno "Crow" Hakkinen tried to describe the smell of Port Abel and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived.

In the dark of the Hegemony trench Arno "Crow" Hakkinen hit Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@slightlyretarded69) News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-F17 with the rations. Arno "Crow" Hakkinen ate while listening to the revised orders.

A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Arno "Crow" Hakkinen. The men named it Old Tom and said it had chosen him. Arno "Crow" Hakkinen got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 171. The men who came later will ask about it. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Arno "Crow" Hakkinen wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Arno "Crow" Hakkinen had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Severin Thky, grazed.
Arno "Crow" Hakkinen had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Casimir Lilsaint was badly wounded.
Old Tom the crow follows Arno "Crow" Hakkinen along the trench now. When Old Tom flies off, men duck. They are usually right to.

On dawn watch at S-F17, Arno "Crow" Hakkinen fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Karel Lilneftrappi, now badly wounded. Arno "Crow" Hakkinen was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Arno Yearslong was grazed.

The Hegemony raiders came over at S-F17 in the middle of the night. Arno "Crow" Hakkinen met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Wendel "Tin" Uwuandrea of the Hegemony (@uwuandrea_).
The papers say Dietrich "Owl" Hakkinen. The sergeant says he has his cousin's eyes. Arno "Crow" Hakkinen's eyes. Nobody in S-F17 argues.
Dietrich "Owl" Hakkinen hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.
Dietrich has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh, grazed.
iuhnowisco: Arno Iuhnowisco arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Arno Iuhnowisco watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools. A letter from home found Arno Iuhnowisco before the night shift. Arno Iuhnowisco folded it small and kept it close.

A parcel came for Arno Iuhnowisco that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: three pairs of woollen mittens. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping. A letter from home found Arno Iuhnowisco before the night shift. Arno Iuhnowisco folded it small and kept it close. The field cooks took Arno Iuhnowisco in on a busy morning in T-F15. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Arno Iuhnowisco watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Arno Iuhnowisco heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously. A letter from home found Arno Iuhnowisco before the night shift. Arno Iuhnowisco folded it small and kept it close.

A flare lit the Sunken Road like noon. Arno Iuhnowisco counted the seconds until darkness: eleven. A letter from home found Arno Iuhnowisco before the night shift. Arno Iuhnowisco folded it small and kept it close.

Arno Iuhnowisco went out with the wiring party at T-F15. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. A letter from home found Arno Iuhnowisco before the night shift. Arno Iuhnowisco folded it small and kept it close.

The cook's fire went out. Arno Iuhnowisco relit it under his own coat and served stew that tasted of wool. A letter from home found Arno Iuhnowisco before the night shift. Arno Iuhnowisco folded it small and kept it close.

Arno Iuhnowisco found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases. Arno Iuhnowisco kept the new letter in a breast pocket all day, and touched the pocket now and then to check it was there.

Arno Iuhnowisco laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago. There was a letter for Arno Iuhnowisco. Someone at home had drawn a small picture in the corner. Arno Iuhnowisco laughed for the first time in days.

Wendel "Hollow" Arthur (Hegemony) shouted a joke across the wire at the Hanging Bridge. Arno Iuhnowisco (Concord) shouted one back. Neither understood the other, and both laughed. There was a letter for Arno and a little tobacco folded inside. The tobacco went round the squad. The letter did not.
joshgentile80: Quentin Joshgentile, a ferryman from Brennmoor, was sent forward on Day 4 to fill a gap in R-F3. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Quentin Joshgentile fired at a movement across the wire at R-F3. The man went down: Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin, grazed.

Quentin Joshgentile had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Florian Wubbarn crossed it, Quentin Joshgentile fired. Florian Wubbarn was grazed. After the loss of Hill 304, Quentin Joshgentile helped stack spare sandbags at R-F3. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Quentin Joshgentile found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
A bullet found Quentin Joshgentile at R-F3, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Ulrich Unstoppable of the Hegemony (@mr.unstoppable213).
Quentin Joshgentile never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.
Quentin Joshgentile's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.

Quentin Joshgentile joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at R-F3. Quentin Joshgentile was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Silas Zeaglermkt of the Hegemony (@zeaglermkt).
Dorian Joshgentile came to the front because his father Quentin Joshgentile never came home. He carries a cracked shaving mirror.

A dog crosses no man's land at Lantern Hill every night, fed by Dorian Joshgentile on one side and Florian Exe on the other. The Concord call it Patrol. The Hegemony call it Spy. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Dorian Joshgentile answered to number 266. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Dorian Joshgentile kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
A round went through Dorian Joshgentile's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Benedikt Falloutvam of the Hegemony (@falloutvam).
The medic cut the last bandage off Dorian Joshgentile's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to R-F3 the same hour.
Karel Lilneftrappi of the Hegemony lost a cap on a night patrol near Verdel Ridge. Dorian Joshgentile of the Concord found it in the morning and now wears it on Sundays.
Dawn watch. Dorian Joshgentile put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Rafael "Spark" Calderthebal, grazed.
A round went through the rim of Dorian Joshgentile's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Zeno Martinvajda of the Hegemony (@martinvajda.21).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Dorian Joshgentile is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Dorian was made Lance Corporal after keeping the section together under fire. He asked that the rest of the section be mentioned too.
kagkhunthod: The draft reached U-F11 on Day 10. Zeno "Hollow" Kagkhunthod was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Zeno "Hollow" Kagkhunthod and Teodor Fleming carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Zeno "Hollow" Kagkhunthod during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Zeno "Hollow" Kagkhunthod sang under his breath on sentry. Across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line.
A loose thread in Zeno "Hollow" Kagkhunthod's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.
Zeno "Hollow" Kagkhunthod and Oskar Mccarter share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.
A round went through Zeno "Hollow" Kagkhunthod's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Oskar Reynolds of the Concord (@chase_reynolds_13).

A bullet found Zeno "Hollow" Kagkhunthod at U-F11, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Clement "Parson" Krut of the Concord (@krut4s3k). Zeno "Hollow" Kagkhunthod looked over the parapet at U-F11 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Clement "Parson" Krut of the Concord (@krut4s3k).
Silas "Whistle" Kagkhunthod came to the front because his brother Zeno "Hollow" Kagkhunthod never came home. He carries his mother's thimble.
Hugo "Mud" Rambam and Silas "Whistle" Kagkhunthod argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Silas aimed just below it. Dietrich "Hollow" Blacksmithsb was grazed. A bullet passed so close to Silas at U-F11 that it burned his neck. The sergeant told him to count that as a haircut. Shot by Gustav Clarke of the Concord (@clarke_070).
mr.fartpants.himself: Nobody asked Marek Himself why he came. Nobody in Q-F8 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into Q-F8. Marek Himself has learned to walk bent double.

The men argued about whether fish sleep. Marek Himself said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know. A letter from home found Marek Himself before the night shift. Marek Himself folded it small and kept it close. After the loss of Grey Mill, Marek Himself helped stack spare sandbags at Q-F8. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

An enemy patrol scattered in front of Q-F8. Marek Himself fired at the last man to run. Jakub Ljuliolemosl was grazed. Marek Himself was hit in the forearm at Q-F8. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Henrik Houghton of the Hegemony (@patrick.houghton.5602).

Marek Himself took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at Q-F8, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Walter Paz of the Hegemony (@anthony_paz). A single shot at Q-F8. Marek Himself sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Walter Paz of the Hegemony (@anthony_paz).
The papers say Oskar Himself. The sergeant says he has his brother's eyes. Marek Himself's eyes. Nobody in Q-F8 argues.
Oskar Himself had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Walter Paz was grazed.
Oskar Himself and Edmund Thswastim sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
Oskar Himself has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Walter Paz, badly wounded.

A clear shot from Q-F8. Oskar Himself grazed Clement "Bones" Catatfire and slid back down below the parapet. The letter for Oskar Himself was written in pencil, with a lot of crossing out. Oskar Himself liked the crossed-out parts best.
Oskar (Concord) and Nils "Ghost" Jlantz (Hegemony) ended up in the same shell hole at the Drowned Farm. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.
nath_.ldn: Day 11: Florian Ldn reached U-F18 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Florian Ldn did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Florian Ldn fixed the strap on Hugo "Button" Ethanbay's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
Florian Ldn was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet went through Florian Ldn's sleeve at U-F18 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve.
The medics cleaned Florian Ldn's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at U-F18.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Florian Ldn's ear at U-F18 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Yann "Spark" Bennyliebs of the Concord (@bennyliebs).
Back on the fire step at U-F18. Florian Ldn says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
Florian replaced a torn sandbag at U-F18 with a new one. A small job. The squad noticed and said nothing, which is a thank you.
navi_oyamat: The old hands of Q-F10 have been here since Day 1. Casimir Oyamat has been here since Day 10. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

A bullet hit Casimir Oyamat in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at Q-F10. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Edmund Thswastim of the Concord (@thswastim05). Casimir Oyamat was killed at Q-F10 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Edmund Thswastim of the Concord (@thswastim05).

The papers connected Bastian "Parson" Oyamat to Casimir Oyamat. The men took longer to learn Bastian "Parson" Oyamat's own habits, but they made the effort. Orders came through: Bastian "Parson" Oyamat is a sapper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a tin of tobacco. Victory at Grey Mill. Bastian "Parson" Oyamat let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

A borrowed pencil wore down while Bastian "Parson" Oyamat was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first. A letter from home found Bastian "Parson" Oyamat before the night shift. Bastian "Parson" Oyamat folded it small and kept it close.

The fog lifted at noon and Bastian "Parson" Oyamat saw the Hanging Bridge clearly for the first time. He wished it had stayed. A letter from home found Bastian "Parson" Oyamat before the night shift. Bastian "Parson" Oyamat folded it small and kept it close.

Bastian "Parson" Oyamat went out with the wiring party at Q-F10. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. A letter from home found Bastian "Parson" Oyamat before the night shift. Bastian "Parson" Oyamat folded it small and kept it close.

A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Bastian "Parson" Oyamat worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost. A letter from home found Bastian "Parson" Oyamat before the night shift. Bastian "Parson" Oyamat folded it small and kept it close.

On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Bastian "Parson" Oyamat was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire. Bastian "Parson" Oyamat spent the night on a stretcher in the trench behind the aid post. Every bed was taken. The letter for Bastian "Parson" Oyamat smelled faintly of soap. Bastian "Parson" Oyamat held it close for a long time before opening it.

A medic brought Bastian "Parson" Oyamat half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real. Someone at home had written the address three times, to be sure. The letter reached Bastian "Parson" Oyamat anyway.

Bastian never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line. The letter for Bastian was written in pencil, with a lot of crossing out. Bastian liked the crossed-out parts best.
sckweet: The draft reached P-F18 on Day 10. Tobias Sckweet was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Tobias Sckweet's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Tobias Sckweet stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
A second spoon disappeared. Tobias Sckweet searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry.
Tobias Sckweet was hit in the foot through his boot at P-F18. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Otto Chuckemuckle of the Hegemony (@chuckemuckle).
Tobias Sckweet survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at P-F18, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post.
Tobias Sckweet lifted the board. The gap contained seven spoons, a button and a pencil people had blamed the quartermaster for losing.

At P-F18 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Tobias Sckweet turned around and took a shovel blow. Casimir Eclark of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Casimir Eclark of the Hegemony (@eclark43).
Tobias Sckweet's bandage soaked through twice in one night. The medic called the bearers before morning.
Tobias sat up in bed, drank some soup, and complained about the soup. Everyone in the ward cheered.
slade_2233: Day 4. The corporal put Cyril "Ash" Slade beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language. The new duty roster listed Cyril "Ash" Slade as a sniper. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

Cyril "Ash" Slade pulled Jakub Mccooper out of a flooded shell hole at the Chalk Pits. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember. A letter from home reached Cyril "Ash" Slade before dusk. Cyril "Ash" Slade read it twice and slept a little easier.

Cyril "Ash" Slade fired at a movement across the wire at S-F3. The man went down: Quentin Khattabka, gravely wounded. The barrage caught Cyril "Ash" Slade in the open at S-F3. The medic tied two tourniquets and shouted for a bed. The shell that hit S-F3 took Cyril "Ash" Slade with it. No stretcher, no surgeon, no last words. Just the crater.

Dietrich "Button" Slade joined S-F3 under the shadow of Cyril "Ash" Slade's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one. Dietrich "Button" Slade's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Dietrich "Button" Slade watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

A clear shot from S-F3. Dietrich "Button" Slade gravely wounded Bram "Bones" Hop and slid back down below the parapet. A letter from home reached Dietrich "Button" Slade before dusk. Dietrich "Button" Slade read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dietrich "Button" Slade wrote a letter for Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer's mother, because Smokes could not find the words. Smokes signed it. A letter from home reached Dietrich "Button" Slade before dusk. Dietrich "Button" Slade read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dietrich "Button" Slade was carrying water up to S-F3 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Dietrich "Button" Slade did not. Shot by Felix "Tin" Singh of the Concord (@jasmandeep_singh999).
No bed for Dietrich "Button" Slade yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.

The stretcher Dietrich "Button" Slade lay on for so long has a dent the shape of a body. Dietrich "Button" Slade is back at S-F3, and someone else is lying in that dent now. Dietrich "Button" Slade walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Dietrich "Button" Slade let the enemy fix the same sandbag three times. The fourth time, Otto Summacon was grazed. The clerk counted the names twice. Dietrich "Button" Slade is number 241 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at S-F3 changed before the cheering ended. Dietrich "Button" Slade shouldered another load.
Dietrich "Button" Slade took the shot at four hundred yards. The spotter whispered the result: Isidor "Doc" Angus, badly wounded.
Dietrich "Button" Slade has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Dietrich "Button" Slade aimed just below it. Pavel Josh was grazed. A letter from home reached Dietrich "Button" Slade before dusk. Dietrich "Button" Slade read it twice and slept a little easier.

A round came through the loophole Dietrich "Button" Slade was watching at S-F3 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Ivo "Mole" Dylansteele of the Concord (@dylansteele71). Dietrich "Button" Slade was killed at S-F3 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Ivo "Mole" Dylansteele of the Concord (@dylansteele71).
Edmund "Spark" Slade had heard about Dietrich "Button" Slade's courage. At S-F3, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
Edmund "Spark" Slade saw the glint of an enemy scope and fired first. The man behind it, Zeno "Shadow" Mw, was gravely wounded.
Edmund "Spark" Slade let three easy targets go by. The fourth was the one worth the risk. Pavel Saturdaynigh was badly wounded.

Edmund fired at the enemy dawn watch from S-F3. Albin Janzhhhhhhhh was badly wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. Edmund got a letter and a pair of mittens. The mittens were too big. Edmund wore them anyway.
